definition: Abandoning a line of reasoning and returning to an earlier state, and across 4 sources both a search primitive and a behaviour that training can install. As a primitive it is one of the two things a tree search adds over a chain -- lookahead and backtracking -- and one archived agent makes it a first-class action alongside reflection in an explicitly reversible trajectory tree, where the component ablation finds the two load-bearing and not interchangeable (removing reflection costs 15.31 average F1, removing backtracking 13.06), which those authors read as knowing the state is unreliable being different from being able to discard it. As an installed behaviour it is what verifiable-reward training measurably adds while it prunes diversity elsewhere: the probability of the reversing move at dead ends rises from 0.0068 to 0.1537 and 0.0647 to 0.1687 on two maze models, and recovery from an injected distractor improves by 4.18 to 29.09 points on mathematics. It is also one of the trace dynamics used to detect reasoning failures.

evidence.note: Generalizes chain-of-thought into a search over a tree of intermediate 'thoughts', letting a model self-evaluate branches, look ahead and backtrack instead of committing to one left-to-right path.
evidence.title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models

evidence.note: Builds prefix trees of semantically equivalent reasoning statements and measures how RLVR changes a model's preference between branches, finding the entropy collapse is not stylistic — the collapse is stronger for semantically distinct continuations than for syntactic variants of the same statement.
evidence.title: BODHI: Do LLMs Branch Out and Discover Heterogeneous Inferences?

evidence.note: Tags every sentence of a reasoning trace by its function and studies the sequence rather than the content, finding that failing SAT traces collapse into repetitive verification and commit early, that failing UNSAT traces run the wrong procedure entirely, and that a prompt naming the missing procedure recovers 84.6% of them.
evidence.title: The Tell-Tale Trace: Detecting Reasoning Failures in LLMs Using Chain-of-Thought Dynamics

evidence.note: Gives a search agent an explicitly reversible trajectory tree with reflect and backtrack as first-class actions, and trains the reflection policy with a dense local signal distilled from a teacher that can see the whole trajectory alongside the sparse terminal reward the local decision is ultimately judged by.
evidence.title: LoongReflect: Boosting Long-Horizon Reflection in Search Agents via Global Perspective Distillation

name: backtracking
